Every victory in the arena begins with a decision outside it.

In Arena of Realms, you take the role of an arena manager, guiding your fighters toward a championship. Recruit your roster, plan training, purchase equipment, combine relics, and set your lineup. The next match puts every decision to the test.

Build Your Championship Team

Choose fighters with distinct signature skills and innate abilities, then build around their strengths. Cover weaknesses, discover combinations between skills, equipment, and relics, and adjust your fighters’ entry order to face the opposition.

Make Every Coin Count

Balance spending on training, shopping, stock refreshes, and wagers. Is a new piece of equipment worth more than lasting stat growth? Choose a manager trait that supports your approach to training, trading, and tournament earnings. Post-match events offer further choices about how to spend your resources.

Watch Your Strategy Come to Life

Fighters battle automatically, using their skills and triggering effects as the duel unfolds. Pixel-art characters fight in atmospheric 3D arenas. Watch each match in full, speed up playback, or resolve it quickly. Pause and inspect the combat log to understand damage, armor, energy, and effect sources before refining your next build.

Fight Through a Double-Elimination Bracket

Sixteen teams compete for the championship, and one defeat still leaves room for a comeback. Advance through the winners’ bracket or fight your way back from the losers’ bracket. Study your opponents’ public information and wager in-game gold or equipment on match outcomes, turning your predictions into another management decision.

Carry Your Progress Into the Next Tournament

Earn Essence through tournament results and unlock more characters, items, and manager traits to expand your options. Previous champions and runners-up return as honor challenges with their recorded builds. Can your new team overcome the champions you helped create?

Compete Solo or in Multiplayer

Take on tournaments alone or join multiplayer rooms for up to eight players. Manage your own team, compete in the same tournament, and watch the duels together as you pursue the championship.

Enter the Arena. Slay your Enemies. Forge Their Gear. Become stronger with every wave, or die in the attempt.

 

While in the Arena you will face 40+ different enemies and bosses in increasingly difficult waves of enemies. Collect and forge gear in order to survive the ever increasing challenge of the Arena. Utilize 50+ swords, spells, bows, potions and more to overcome the enemies you will face.

Loot, Forge (Upgrade), Buy, and Sell your gear to maximize your monster slaying potential within the Arena

 

Fight through waves upon waves of enemies to complete the bestiary and armory collections.

 

Fight through the arena your way, with gameplay modifiers and difficulty settings to fine-tune the gameplay experience for yourself. Or even accomplish the game's greatest achievement of DAMO (Demon all Modifiers on).

 

For a change of pace or even greater challenge enter the Onslaught, Arena of the Forge's boss rush mode where you will face endless waves of bosses with no standard waves to act as a reprieve.

A Tale of Swords and Sorcery from Another World

Memories of a past life awaken in a moment of crisis, and the journey to protect a fortress is only beginning. In the vast fantasy world of Vonimir, play as Dirus and fight alongside Aurelia and your companions. Gather allies, investigate a hidden conspiracy, and set out to save Astralhold, gradually uncovering the secrets buried within this land.

Arisen Force: Vonimir is an A-RPG that blends exquisite HD pixel art, fast-paced action combat, and the charm of medieval fantasy adventure. As the next evolution of the Arisen Force series, this title deepens the combat system while enriching the story, exploration, and adventure elements.

Features

  • Exhilarating Combat: A finely polished action system featuring dodge, heavy strikes, parries, blade clashes, finishing moves, precision timing, cancels, and more.

  • Weapon Modules: Daggers, longswords, claymores, spears, bows, staves, and gauntlets—each with unique branching skills and combat techniques.

  • Deep Tactical Play: Instantly switch teammates, execute cooperative combos, master precise swaps, and unleash the Odin Ultimate and Crow Spirit systems.

  • Flexible Builds: Freely swap equipment and skills, reset a universal talent tree, and combine with character-exclusive abilities for countless playstyles.

  • Intense Boss Battles: Bosses feature multi-phase encounters, counterattacks, grapples, defensive mechanics, and even devastating combo or fusion attacks.

  • Journey Skills: Steal, duel, scout, break hidden seals, and discover treasures to enrich your exploration.

  • Stunning Pixel Art: From villages to castles, deserts to icy plains, experience a world that feels like a living painting.

  • Immersive Environments: Towns and landscapes shift dynamically through dawn, day, dusk, and night.

  • A Story of Fate: Follow Dirus as he awakens to memories of a past life and uncovers the secrets of Vonimir on a journey to protect his companions and their fortress.

  • Trusted Companions: Rescue and recruit allies, equip them with gear and skills, and build your exclusive fighting force.

  • Flavors of the Journey: Beyond the main adventure, enjoy taverns, forging, enchanting, crafting, dismantling, and a variety of side activities.

Storyline

Astralhold, a fortress that holds back the Aberrations, faces a dual threat: dwindling supplies and a conspiracy unfolding in the shadows. In the wake of a crisis, Dirus awakens to memories of a past life and takes on the responsibility of protecting his companions and the fortress.

To thwart the schemes of those pulling the strings and save Astralhold, you will set out alongside Aurelia and the companions you meet along the way. Follow clues, seek aid, and confront powerful enemies. Through each choice and battle, uncover the secrets that shroud Vonimir.

From the Greenshade Forest to the Bone Lord's dark lair a hero's tale begins with you.

Arkney: The Bone Road is a handcrafted pixel action RPG about a realm slowly being consumed by the Bone Road a creeping corruption that turns forests to ash and the dead to soldiers. Take up your sword, light the waystones, and push it back.

Fast, readable combat

Dash, swing, and kite your way through wolf packs, ghoul hordes and bone knights. Every monster telegraphs, every hit counts and death always costs you something.

A living world

The world doesn't wait for you. Dynamic weather, day/night cycles, world events, roaming golden variants worth hunting, and an Ancient world boss that emerges on its own schedule. Take hunt contracts to track down marked prey.

Three chapters, three realms

  • Chapter I: Greenshade Forest: wolves, root wraiths, and the Bone Lord's vanguard
  • Chapter II: The Frostlands: frozen lakes, crystal golems, and the Ice Queen
  • Chapter III: The Cinder Throne: magma hounds, inferno knights, and the Inferno Lord

Gather, craft, grow

Eight life skills; mining, smithing, woodcutting, fishing, cooking, alchemy and more. Forge five weapon tiers, enchant your gear, unlock the rune tree, and raise a pet companion.

Two-player online co-op

Invite a friend with a link and play 2-player co-op host-authoritative over WebRTC, no dedicated server and no extra accounts.

A world with memory

Lore stones, chapter cutscenes, quest lines and a built-in wiki the Bone Road has a history, if you care to dig it up.

Jump into epic WW2 online PvP combat! Army Troop Remastered brings the classic Army Troop to life with immersive 4K graphics and enhanced realism. This remastered version offers a complete overhaul, with every sound, music, effect, UI, animation, and 3D model redesigned for a more dynamic experience, featuring 4K textures.

Intense WW2 Battles

Dive into intense online PvP combat and battle players from around the world across a variety of exciting WW2 maps. Play alongside or against your friends in both online and private matches, including Team Deathmatch, Free-for-All, and Domination, with support for up to 24 players in 5v5 and 12v12 battles, plus full support for AI bots in online and offline matches.

Play Online Or Offline

The game features our best AI bot system, where bots react almost like real players, ensuring every match is filled with challenging action—even when no players are online.

Play exclusively with bots in full offline mode, without an internet connection, with adjustable bot difficulty and progression preserved. Full Steam Cloud support keeps your saved progression synchronized when online.

No login or account creation required! Jump straight into the action and start playing instantly.

Fight Anytime. Never Wait.

No empty servers. No waiting. No dead lobbies.

Play online against real players, battle Intelligent AI Bots, or enjoy full PvE bot matches whenever you want. AI soldiers automatically fill online matches whenever players are missing, keeping every battle active and competitive.

Whether the server is full or you're the only player online, the fight is always ready.

Choose Your Soldier

Select from a variety of WW2 soldiers, including Infantry, Recon, Tank Crew, Paratrooper, and more, each bringing their own style to the battlefield.

Build Your Arsenal

Choose from a wide array of WW2 weapons, including Assault Rifles, SMGs, Snipers, Shotguns, Pistols and LMGs, and prepare your loadout for battle.

Customize Your Loadout

Customize your class with perks, weapon skins, and accessories like sight scopes and silencers to suit your playstyle.

One Progression. Every Match Counts

Your progression never stops.

Fight real players or battle AI bots—both reward the same XP, Ranks, and Unlocks.

Level up, earn XP, unlock new Soldiers, expand your arsenal, and keep progressing no matter how you choose to play online or offline.

Ongoing Updates

New content, including maps, characters, weapons, skins, perks, accessories, and game modes, is regularly added.

With improved optimization and matchmaking, Army Troop Remastered provides the ultimate WW2 FPS experience for both newcomers and veterans.

No waiting. No empty servers. Just join, fight, unlock, and keep progressing.

Ashen Throne is a free-to-play, top-down action MMORPG. Explore the world on your own, take on bosses with friends, or join a guild and fight for control of Ashen Castle.


Three playable classes at launch

  • Warrior: Close-range attacks, heavy armour and powerful weapon skills.
  • Wizard: Ranged spells and area attacks for fighting groups of enemies.
  • Taoist: Fight with a summoned companion, healing and poison.

Each class has 12 active skills. Set up debuffs and follow with combo attacks, or use optional auto-combat and auto-cast.

Dungeons and world bosses

Travel through towns, forests, desert ruins and underground dungeons across Bichon, Mongchon and Eldergrove. New areas and tougher bosses open up as you level.


Equipment and progression

Find equipment, gather materials and craft weapons, armour and supplies. Improve your skills with practice and skill books, reroll your equipment's bonus stats, and collect appearances in the Wardrobe.

Guild wars and PvP

Fight for mining valleys in Territory Wars and battle for Ashen Castle in Castle War. Holding territory earns your guild Bloodsteel tax, and taking part earns rewards whether you win or lose.

Open-world PvP is available in later provinces, where defeat can cost you items you're carrying. Castle War deaths do not cause item loss.

Wishlist rewards

Community wishlist milestones unlock launch rewards for every player. At 500 Steam wishlists, the first bundle includes 5 Enchant Stones and 5 each of Weapon, Armour and Accessory Enhance items.


Free to play

Optional battle passes support development and include faster gathering and questing, remote salvage selling and gameplay buffs.

Ashigaru Tactics is a hex-based tactical RPG set in Sengoku era Japan. The land is ravaged by clan warfare, bandit incursions, and rumours of Yokai are emerging. Assemble a squad of men and lead them through this chaotic era. Take on contracts for money, kill and loot your way through the land, and equip your men as they level up and grow stronger - the ones that survive long enough.

INSPIRATION

Ashigaru Tactics is a homage to Battle Brothers and the mercenary sandbox RPG genre it helped define, with its own take on perk trees inspired by the excellent Perk Trees Rework (PTR) mod. Ashigaru builds on those foundations with its own ideas for tactical combat, building your company, and sandbox gameplay, all shaped by the weapons, warfare, and brutal world of Sengoku-era Japan.

NEW FEATURES

Over 150+ perks for build variety

Many expected quality-of-life features (speedup etc)

The game has a procedurally generated world map layout, which you can freely move around and visit towns for gear and contracts, as well as hiring new squad members.

The battles are hex-based tactical combat, make the best use of your squad members and their skills, careful positioning, and sometimes just go all in on a lucky hit roll gamble.

Your squad is assembled from a mix of farmers, monks, militia, ronin, and more. If you have the money, get the best men you can find. Just make sure you can cover their wages.

Your squad members will level up through XP in combat, giving them improved attributes and perks that will make them stronger and more specialized in battle. Each squad member can be built in many different ways, so experiment and make the most of them.

Many squad members will die as you make your way through the troubled world. The ones that live on will have glory.

Enter a manor where every portrait hides a secret.

In Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love, you step into a decaying family estate haunted not by monsters, but by silence. The Ashrose family has preserved its legacy in oil, wood, and dust — yet one name has been scratched away, one portrait has vanished, and one forbidden love was never meant to be remembered.

As Evelyn, you arrive at Ashrose Manor and begin piecing together the truth hidden within its halls. Examine portraits, read forgotten journal entries, investigate old guest books, and uncover the story of Julian Vale, a restorer whose presence in the manor was deliberately erased.

Investigate. Collect clues. Rebuild the past.

Explore atmospheric rooms such as the entrance hall and the artist’s studio, where the manor’s most important secret waits to be uncovered. Every object can become a clue: an overpainted nameplate, a missing frame, a guest book entry from 1954, or a torn fragment of a painting.

Your journal acts as both your memory and your investigation board. Important discoveries are automatically recorded, allowing you to connect clues and unlock new conclusions as the story unfolds. This matches the intended journal-based clue system, where evidence such as Julian Vale, the overpainted nameplate, and the missing portrait lead to a larger realization.

Restore the portrait. Reveal the forbidden love.

At the heart of the prototype is a focused mystery loop: explore the manor, find fragments, restore a painting, and uncover what the Ashrose family tried to hide. The planned mini-prototype centers on a main menu, an intro, the entrance hall, the atelier, one central puzzle, a journal, a memory scene, and a final teaser ending.

The deeper you investigate, the clearer it becomes: Julian Vale was not just a visitor. His connection to the family was dangerous enough to be erased from every wall, every record, and every memory.

Features

  • Explore an atmospheric gothic manor in first person

  • Investigate portraits, documents, and environmental clues

  • Record discoveries and connect clues through your journal

  • Solve environmental and narrative puzzles

  • Restore a mysterious portrait to uncover lost memories

  • Discover a story of forbidden love, secrecy, and loss

About the Prototype

This playable prototype offers an early look at the atmosphere, exploration, storytelling, and mystery mechanics of Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love.

The game is currently in development, so content, visuals, mechanics, and performance may change in future versions.

If you enjoy the prototype, consider wishlisting Ashrose Manor – A Portrait of Forbidden Love on Steam.

Credits

Special thanks and credits to:

LUMI Studio, Pablo Wunderlich, artsystack, Ida Faber, Art Equilibrium

Generative AI was used to assist in the creation of selected 2D images, sprite assets, and marketing artwork, including some Steam capsule and store assets. It was also used for proofreading and editing written text. All AI-assisted content was reviewed, selected, and refined by the developer before being included in the game or official marketing materials.

AsterMaster is a beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Everything on the grid moves to one metronome: enemies step and strike on the beat, you step with them, and a shot that lands on the beat bites harder. Dig into a dead mining asteroid, break what guards it, and haul your ore back out alive.

HULLS THAT BREAK WHERE YOU HIT

Bosses, elites and your own ship are built from Gaussian splats: about five thousand glowing shards and a hundred chunks each. Every hit carves a real crater where it lands, and each damage type leaves its own mark. Strip the plating and chunks tear off. When a boss crosses a damage threshold, its most battered part breaks away for good. The destruction core is native C++, so the shards fly at full frame rate.

SEVEN CHAMPIONS, ONE PART AT A TIME

Elite enemies with destructible hulls — Pack Alpha, Battery, Bastion, The Eye, Shepherd, Hive Mother, Sower. Each run rolls its own three from the seed. Which part comes off depends on what you shoot with and from where: a direct shot takes the nose or the stern, a mortar shell caves in the top. A champion missing a part fights differently.

EVERYTHING MOVES ON THE BEAT


Every attack is telegraphed on the hex grid. Read the pattern, step into the gap, fire on the downbeat — off-beat volleys ricochet off armour. Take hits and your Neuro-Link degrades… run it red-hot for a comeback. A checkpoint at every arena gate and one Reconnect per run.

DIG DEEP, GET OUT ALIVE

Every run is an expedition across a procedural mine graph: surface zones, boss-gated descents down to the crimson depths, and orbital fragments where smugglers pay extra for your ore. Drilling makes NOISE — the deeper you strip the asteroid, the harder the swarm pushes back. Clear a segment and the asteroid itself splits apart beneath you. Bank your cargo at a station, or gamble it on one more descent.

BUILD A MONSTER

15 weapon mods, 3 slots, modifiers stack up to ×3. Four barrels — sniper, railgun, mortar, cutter — and eleven modifiers: thermite burns, ricochet volleys, cryo blocks, gravity wells. Mods of one archetype fuse into synergies that reshape the whole run. Eight powerups on top: an innate blink-dash, auto-block, arc coil, a holographic decoy. Between runs, feed cores into a meta-tree: new mods, powerups and synergies, a fourth mod slot, a bigger cargo hold.

  • Beat-synced hex combat — position is a weapon, timing is everything
  • Destructible splat hulls: bosses, seven champions and your own ship crater where you hit them
  • Procedural mine graph: secret halls, collapsed pockets, tunnels, orbit runs
  • 15 mods, 8 powerups, stacking and archetype synergies
  • 5 bosses + elite wardens, 14 enemy types, a final gauntlet of holding halls
  • Ore economy: extract, bank, or push your luck deeper
  • Daily Challenge, 3 difficulties, meta-progression, 62 achievements
  • Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly, English + Russian

Remember when you'd get home from school, fire up the family computer, and lose hours chasing high scores in your favorite Flash games?

Astral Boost brings that feeling back. Inspired by the golden age of Flash games and classics, this relaxing, score-chasing arcade experience challenges you to build momentum, soar through the atmosphere, and see just how far into space you can go. One more run. One higher score. Just like the good old days.

Your objective is simple: go as far as possible and earn the highest score you can. Mastering the skies takes skill. Each cloud you strike launches you forward, creating opportunities to build speed, momentum, and extend your run. The longer your chain, the faster the game becomes, testing your reflexes as difficulty increases.

How high can you go?

A Deck-Building Roguelike Meets the TCG

Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel is a fantasy card game where a deck-building roguelike adventure and a strategic trading card game share the same cards, heroes and battlefield. Draft a deck on the fly and dive into the dungeon, or build your collection and refine the perfect 30-card deck.

Roguelike Dungeon

  • Pick a hero and start right away with the Basic Deck, or draft your own 12 cards one at a time.

  • Three acts, each with a branching map. Choose your path through battles, elite fights, the Forge for relics, Mei's Curio Shop, camps and unknown places where anything can happen.

  • Every act ends with a hero boss, and you can see who waits for you from the start.

  • Win battles to earn gold and new cards, and grow a different deck every run.

Relics

  • Equip a weapon, armor and accessory relic.

  • Relics grant extra mana, more max HP, a bigger hand, more gold or shop discounts.

  • Finding the same relic again upgrades it. At a camp, rest to recover HP or upgrade one relic (up to Lv3).

Mei's Curio Shop

  • Buy cards and relics from Mei, the curio dealer.

  • Pay to remove weak cards and keep your deck sharp.

Tactical Card Battles

Battles play out as charming pixel art inside a retro CRT screen, and with AUTO on, your deck fights on its own. Every fight is a turn-based duel. Draw cards, gain mana, summon units onto the battlefield, cast spells, set traps and unleash hero skills with dramatic cut-ins. Reduce the enemy hero's life to 0 to win.

Build Your Collection

  • Every new account receives three starter decks: Fire, Water and Forest.

  • Build 30-card decks with up to 4 copies of a card.

  • Five card types: characters, structures, equipment, spells and traps.

  • Every hero has a unique skill that shapes your strategy.

  • Earn currency, cards and crafting materials from every match.

Key Features

  • Deck-building roguelike dungeon with branching maps and hero bosses

  • Relics with three upgrade levels

  • Turn-based tactical card battles

  • Collectible TCG deck building with five card types

  • Unique heroes with skill cut-ins

A 2D pixel-art mining game about digging through procedurally generated planets and carving your own path through the stars.

  • Procedurally generated planets — No two landings are the same. Each visit reshapes the terrain and its risk/reward zones.

  • Chart your own route — Freely pick your next destination on the star map, weighing distance against danger and opportunity.

  • Explore & collect — Dig deep to uncover rare ores and fill out your mineral compendium.

  • Level up — Spend your earnings on gear upgrades that make you a faster, tougher, more efficient miner.

  • Invest — Grow your fortune beyond mining by putting spare credits into a fluctuating stock market.

Pixel-art visuals, full controller support, English & Japanese localization.

Drop tetrominoes, pentominoes, and -oes of various other kinds to defeat weird space monsters in roguelite battles that span the cosmos...

Collect Relics and enhance your Pieces with Stamps to build a bag that can combo down even the most troublesome bosses!

Unlock and play as far-future sci-fi characters, each adding new wrinkles to how you strategize.

At once, My Lord! is a cozy cleanup simulator with one simple goal: pick up every chunk of human (or not-so-human) remains and toss them into interdimensional recycling portals.

There are 21 different types of body parts to collect, plus a voodoo doll that's worth a whole lot more gold than your average severed limb. Spend your hard-earned gold on useful upgrades and turn a battlefield covered in carnage into a desolate wasteland... but a clean one.

A Cozy Corpse Cleanup Simulator

The battle of Kor'Vhar is over, and the entrance to Lord Shellborn's castle is absolutely littered with dismembered heroes who fought valiantly... or at least managed to throw a punch or two.

No rush. No pressure. Just picking up bits of people.

Well... there is some pressure.

If you manage to clean everything up before dinner, Lord Shellborn himself may graciously decide to appear before you. And who knows? You might even earn yourself a promotion in this filthy pile of rocks and half-collapsed architecture.

Collect. Recycle. Repeat.

Once you've gathered an armful of assorted body parts, haul them over to an interdimensional recycling portal and cash them in for some gold. Where do all those heroic remains actually go? No idea. Not that anyone really cares... Right?

Upgrade Your Movement, Carrying Capacity, and Recycling Skills

Unlock powerful upgrades that let you move farther, better, and faster. Carry more body parts to the portal in a single trip and, well... unlock a few other things you'll discover as you progress.

Key Features

- Recycle over 10,000 body parts scattered across Kor'Vhar
- Earn some cash for every chunk you toss into an interdimensional portal
- Unlock up to three recycling portals across the map, because walking is overrated
- Upgrade your abilities with up to 15 upgrades and 4 special abilities
- Relaxing and satisfying gameplay
- Watch the ground slowly become cleaner and cleaner... well, emptier, at least. The blood isn't going anywhere. That's just how it is.

Build matter, one bond at a time

Atom By Atom is a minimalist factory automation game where raw elements flow through Matter Tubes and are bonded into precise molecular structures. Your factory surrounds a hungry black hole. It wants specific molecules.

Extract, route, react

Discover elemental clouds in a seeded world, place Extractors, and draw continuous Tube networks. Dividers balance materials between production lines, while automatic bridges let routes cross without mixing. Later, Wormholes connect distant parts of the factory, a unique factory game mechanic.

Structure matters

Every molecule keeps its atoms, bond orders, connectivity, and open valences. A formula is only the beginning: what you feed into a machine determines what can come out.

Start by producing H2 and H2O. Later, unlock machines that cleave, substitute, oxidize, cyclize, polymerize, condense and hydrolyze increasingly complex matter.

Visual markers show unused valences, machine inputs, outputs and moving molecular structures. Exact step-by-step recipes are available when a new reaction is introduced.

Feed the black hole

Complete molecular contracts to advance, unlock new elements and machines and transform a simple extraction line into a sprawling chemical factory. The black hole accepts deliveries from every side and turns production goals into the center of your layout.

Scale your solution

Trace long Tube paths, rotate and flip machines, copy and paste production blocks, and save reusable Blueprints that you can share with anybody. Seeded maps, minimap markers, factory statistics, machine efficiency readouts, portable save codes are just a few of the many functions this game offers.

A must have for any factory game, space and chemistry enthusiast!

Build matter. Atom by atom.

Build by day. Survive the night. Together or against each other.

You arrive with nothing but your fists and a forest full of wood, stone, and gold. By daylight you gather, build, and grow. When the sun sets, darklings crawl out of their portals to tear down everything you've made. Every night the assault grows, until you start fighting back.

Play Your Way

  • Solo : build, survive, and hunt the Dark Lord at your own pace.

  • Online Co-op (PvE) : team up with up to 4 players to share a town, split the labor, and hold the walls against the horde.

  • Online PvP : start your own settlements and race, raid, and outlast rival players for control of the map.

  • Local Split-Screen : grab a friend on the couch for two-player co-op or head-to-head PvP on one screen.

Raise a Settlement

  • Five tiers of buildings : start with a humble house and palisade, climb through farms, mines, towers, and strongholds, all the way to mage towers, castles and dragon's nests.

  • Radial build & interact wheels : place structures, upgrade them, and craft tools right in the world.

  • Walls & palisades : fortify your town with straight runs and corners to slow the horde.

Recruit & Specialize Villagers

  • Turn idle villagers into lumberjacks, miners, farmers, builders, hunters, militia, knights and mages.

  • Workers gather, build, repair, and fight — the more hands on a project, the faster it evolves.

  • Balance food, labor, and defense as your population grows.

Fight the Dark

  • Punch, chop, mine, shoot arrows, and cast spells — the game auto-selects the right weapon for the target.

  • A deep damage system of blunt, pierce, fence, fire, ice, lightning, and poison, with counters that matter.

  • Darklings unlock new weapons and spells over time — hesitate and the nightly raids escalate.

Explore & Expand

  • Deplete local resources and strike out to found new specialized towns around rare deposits.

  • Clear the portals threatening your settlements and connect your towns with trading posts.

  • Visibility shifts with time and terrain — clearings, forests, and caves each reveal or hide the world.

  • Venture into the unknown : brave dark caves and dungeons, and face off against fearsome creatures guarding their depths.

Effortless to Play, Endlessly Deep

  • No cluttered HUD, no menu maze : the world is the interface. What you see is what you play.

  • One action button drives everything: gather, build, craft, recruit, and fight, all from a single intuitive control.

  • No two runs alike : procedurally generated maps, depleting resources, shifting portals, villager choices, and each night's escalating raids make every session play out differently.

The Long Road to the Dark Lord

We hope that we get to support and improve this game for a long time and add numerous features and make Aubelys world feel alive.

AudioSpeed is an audio game centred on high-speed races between spaceships. Totally accessible for blind players

In the far future, pilots race not cars, but starships on a number of orbital tracks.

With high gravity, hyperspacial acceleration and hazards such as nebulae this is an extremely dangerous sport.

The main tournament of the game takes place on 7 tracks, culminating in a showdown at the system Hydra, where only the toughest pilots will survive.

Players select from various starships, each with unique stats for

  • speed

  • maneuverability

  • armor

  • acceleration

  • robo-navigator efficiency.

Options include practicing on the first five tracks or competing in the tournament. Because the tournament requires achieving specific, challenging times to avoid disqualification, strong racing skills are necessary.

Multiplayer: Video vs Audio

Challenge a sighted friend to the fastest lap. You race by ear, reading the track through sound; they race by sight, reading it on screen. Same track, same moment, two completely different ways of driving it — may the best pilot win.

[Rules aren't meant to be followed; they're meant to be rewritten.]

A cyberspace within a space observatory where endless starlight flows. Victory here isn't decided simply by luck and point calculations. Whoever modifies the rules of the board first determines the outcome. Share authority with one of two opposing management assistant AIs, If and Else, and twist the rules of Mahjong with the Augment cards given each round to seize first place!

[Key Features]

■ Augments — Weapons That Rewrite the Rules

At the start of every hand, pick a rule-modifying card that applies to you alone. Beyond the shared pool, exclusive cards unlock through your Guide and in team play — there isn't a single filler card in the deck.

■ System Overrides — Global Disasters that Strike Everyone

If Augments are your personal weapons, System Overrides are common variables that tighten the noose around all four players.

■ Guide Selection: The Chaos of IF vs. The Order of ELSE

The exclusive Augment cards you can draw will change depending on who you team up with in the lobby.

■ Custom Interface from Beginners to Veterans

Easy Explanation Mode: Turn this on if complex Mahjong terminology is unfamiliar. All Augments and System Rules are instantly translated into intuitive, beginner-friendly sentences.

4 AI Difficulties: Supports various AI levels, from aggressive bots aiming to minimize Shanten (tiles away from winning) to balanced bots that comprehensively calculate expected values, defense, and Augment variables.

■ Custom Room: Take Control of the Match Environment

Adjust the appearance rates of Augment cards by tier (Normal / Rare / Legendary).

Toggle System Overrides On/Off and adjust thinking time (Base + Banked time).

Set Tobi (Bankruptcy) match-end conditions and the number of Aka Dora (Red Fives).

Individually assign AI difficulty and personality (If / Else) for each empty seat. The entire aspect of the game changes completely based on the host's settings.

■ Campaign Mode: A Roguelite Run Through a Collapsing Mainframe

Autobus is a competitive card game built around one simple goal: be the first player to empty your main pile. Getting there is anything but simple.

Every turn you're racing to play as many cards as possible onto the shared build piles in the center of the table — but the moment you place a card from your hand onto one of your own piles, your turn is over and the next player takes their shot. Timing your plays, reading the table, and knowing when to hold back separates good players from great ones.

How to Play

Each player manages three areas:

  • Main Pile — your target. The top card is always visible and playable. Empty it and you win.

  • Laying Piles — four personal slots. Cards of the same value stack here; build them up to unlock plays.

  • Hand — five cards you draw and play from each turn.

In the center of the table are four shared build piles. On your turn, play cards from your hand, laying piles, or main pile onto them in ascending order — Ace through King, any suit. You can chain as many legal plays as you can find. When you're done (or stuck), your last move is placing a card from your hand onto one of your laying piles or back onto your main pile — that ends your turn.

Jokers are wildcards. They can be played onto any build pile at any time, giving you a lifeline when nothing else fits.

The Snake you know is a single-player high-score game. This is a duel.


Two snakes on one board, five powers to ruin each other's run, and one rule that changes everything: the one who ate more wins, not the one who survived.

When Snake grew into a multiplayer game, it grew massive: hundreds of snakes on one map, not a duel between two. And of the Snake games on Steam, none has an online mode. Most "Snake for two" games are also two runs side by side: each player on their own board, unable to touch the other. Here there is one board, and the snakes get in each other's way, cut each other off, and collide. That gap is where BACKBITE sits.

Dying isn't always losing


When a snake crashes, the match doesn't end there. If you were ahead on points — or if you were tied — your rival gets 15 seconds to beat your score racing the clock alone. If they fail, you win, even though you died first. No stars and no powers during the chase: the apple, the clock and nothing else.

Five powers


  • SWAP — swaps both snakes' positions. At the worst possible moment.
  • PORTAL — two teleporters on the board for 15 seconds.
  • SPEED — double speed for 5 seconds.
  • SLOW — freezes your rival to half speed for 5 seconds.
  • STEAL — takes a point and a segment from them, and that point becomes yours. A two-point swing, instantly.
Powers come from stars that appear on the board, and which one you get is drawn by a roulette when you pick it up. There's only ever one star at a time: whoever reaches it first takes it.

The golden apple


Every so often a golden apple appears: it's worth 3 points but only grows you by one segment. It lasts a few seconds — a ring shows how much time is left — and then turns back into a normal apple. It's the one that turns a scoreboard around in a single bite, and the one that sends both snakes to the same place at the same time.

Four ways to play


  • 2 Players local — two people, one keyboard.
  • Online — a direct match between both machines with a 5-character room code.
  • VS Bot — four difficulties. The fourth one is called IMPOSSIBLE and it means it.
  • 1 Player — you against your own record.

18 snakes to unlock

Each skin opens by doing something concrete: reaching a certain score against a certain difficulty, winning online matches, beating the Impossible bot more than once. Locked ones show as silhouettes from day one, so you always know what's left.

No coins, no crates, no microtransactions. They unlock by playing.

“Do you know? Around here, the ones who stand out are the first to break… So at least, don’t break right in front of me.”

Cha Seoyun, the cold apex of Hando High School, hides an empathy she simply cannot bring herself to ignore behind those sharp warnings that seem almost aimed at herself.

“Just the bare minimum of solidarity.”

Using that as an excuse, she becomes a precarious shield, reaching out to you from the farthest distance whenever you find yourself in the heart of danger—yet holding on more firmly than anyone else.

She once surrounded herself with harsh armor and raised her thorns high, protecting herself from the eyes of others and the cold ground beneath her. But faced with your almost foolishly straightforward sincerity, she slowly begins to tear down the walls she built to keep herself trapped.

“Don’t get the wrong idea. It’s not for your sake… I just don’t want to watch you break right in front of my eyes.”

Caught between cold warnings and a heavy bond, she protects the solidarity she shares with you with an awkwardness that belies the deeper resolve she carries than anyone else.

■ Dangerous Relationships

Desire, jealousy, and manipulation —
every relationship comes with a price.

As you grow closer to other students, you will uncover their true intentions.
But be careful: trust is fragile,
and not everyone is who they seem.

■ Choices & Consequences

Every choice you make shapes the story.

Your decisions will change relationships, unlock new story paths,
and lead to multiple endings — not all of them are happy.

Will you take control of your own fate,
or be drawn into something you can’t escape?

■ A Dark School Story

This is a school filled with problem students.
Secrets and rumors spread endlessly, and tension never fades.

In a world where even the smallest decision can change everything,
no relationship is ever simple.

And every ending comes at a cost.

Every relationship has risks.
Every choice has consequences.
And not every story ends the way you want.

BALLRENA is a build-crafting auto-battler roguelite driven by physical collisions.

Choose a CORE that defines your ball's basic playstyle, buy components of all shapes and sizes from the shop, then fit them onto a grid with only 5x5 slots. Move, rotate, sell, and merge parts to turn limited space into a fighting machine of your own design.

Once battle begins, your ball enters the arena and carries out everything you installed. Every crash, ricochet, and triggered effect is your build answering the challenge.



Components are not icons in a list. Their shapes occupy actual slots on your build grid.

To fit more parts, you must move, rotate, and rethink the space you have. Do you patch a weakness, keep building around a key component, or save room for the next shop? No good idea should be wasted carelessly.



Your CORE determines your battle ball's defining ability and overall direction. Equipment adds weapons, stats, triggers, and special rules.

Find matching equipment to merge and upgrade it. Chase high-tier components, or combine a wider collection of parts into elaborate chains. The same CORE can become a completely different battle ball depending on how you build it.





Send your completed battle ball into the arena and watch it collide head-on with the enemy. The ball fights automatically, but every weapon activation, ability trigger, and collision chain begins with a choice you made before the fight.

Feeling strong enough? Take a Bounty and challenge a more dangerous enemy for extra rewards. Need room to breathe instead? An Assistance Clause can weaken the enemy in any non-BOSS battle, but the rewards will be reduced as well.



After each battle, return to the shop and turn your winnings into new opportunities for your build.

Buy duplicate parts to complete an upgrade, or tear everything apart around an unexpected key component. Every purchase competes for the same limited money and space, and a higher price does not always mean greater power.

Whenever you merge equipment to a higher tier, choose one of three permanent upgrades for that component. Under the right conditions, some parts can even make money for you. If it fits and the chain works, then it truly belongs to your build.



Keep expanding your assembly throughout a run and use CORE skills with run-wide effects to bend stable rules in your favor. Adapt to different enemies and arenas, and find the combination that makes the entire machine come alive.



Retro arcade flavor, soft and distinctive visuals, and crisp, violent collision feedback. There is no ready-made perfect loadout here—only a 5x5 console and a ball waiting to be rebuilt from the inside out.

Build it. Then sit back and let it crash.

BATTLE: PARTS & POWER is a strategy auto-battler where you build the robots that fight for you. Equip independent production lines, defend your headquarters and adapt your army to the next threat.

Build an army, part by part


Give each of up to five factories its own robot design, weapon, frame and modules. Balance damage, range, durability and production speed. Equipment changes affect newly produced robots, so you can reshape your army during battle.

Make every part count


In Campaign, recover parts from enemies and complete missions to unlock equipment. Try different rarity tiers and merge compatible parts for a chance at higher rarity. Your equipment, factory upgrades and Campaign progress carry over between attempts.

Read the battle


Your robots move and fight automatically. Study incoming enemies, plan around weapon immunities and elemental defenses, and activate support skills at the right moment. Waves, minibosses and bosses put your choices to the test.

Choose your battle


  • Campaign: Advance through stages, unlock equipment and develop your army.
  • Endless Solo: Start a fresh run, earn coins, buy parts and see how far you can go.
  • Duo Endless: Fight alongside a friend, each managing your own factories, inventory and coins.
  • Duel: Face a friend with fresh armies and equal starting conditions.

Bring a friend


To play Duo Endless or a Duel together, both players must own the full game on Steam and use the full version. Invite a friend from within the full game. Duo Endless and Duel are not available in the demo.

SHE DIED DEFENDING HER KINGDOM

BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya is a cinematic boss rush built around reflexes and precision.

Fraya was a warrior queen. After she fell in battle protecting her people, Mayinalli—a cosmic god who gathers the finest warriors killed in combat—brought her back to life and took her to a coliseum where fighters and creatures from different eras, mythologies and realities battle for his amusement.

Mayinalli forces her to fight as an enslaved gladiator for his amusement, offering her no freedom and making no promise that she will return to her kingdom.


FIGHT INSIDE THE ACTION

Each confrontation unfolds across cinematic sequences as targets appear and move around the battlefield. Track them and strike precisely before they disappear. The exact point of impact determines the strength of your attack, so learning every enemy's movements and patterns is essential.

EVERY HIT COUNTS

Precise hits deal more damage, strengthen your combo and can trigger critical strikes. Misses injure Fraya, break her momentum and may end the attempt.

  • Manage Fraya's health and the enemy's endurance.
  • Track stationary, moving and dangerous targets.
  • Maintain your combo to increase your power.
  • Adapt to different patterns, speeds and phases.
  • Improve your accuracy, best combo and completion time.


FACE 17 CHAMPIONS

Mayinalli's coliseum brings together incompatible worlds: ice warriors, winged beasts, knights, spectres, ancient creatures and fighters from unknown realities. Each champion has different patterns, target layouts, speeds and phases.

TURN PRECISION INTO POWER

Earn a performance rating after every fight. Replay encounters to obtain up to three stars, reach Bronze, Silver, Gold and Legend ranks, improve your records and pursue a perfect victory.

DEVELOP FRAYA

Use campaign resources to develop eleven offensive and defensive attributes. Equip up to six to create a build suited to your way of playing.


TRY THE FIRST BATTLES FOR FREE

The demo includes an interactive tutorial, the first five campaign chapters, five champions, the core health, damage, accuracy, combo, star and rank systems, early progression options, full mouse, keyboard and controller support, and local demo progress saving.

MASTER THE COLISEUM

Complete a linear campaign of cinematic confrontations focused on reflexes, precision, pattern recognition and improving your results.

Can Fraya defeat Mayinalli's champions and face the god who controls her fate?

A SINGLE PLAYER NARRATIVE SURVIVAL EXPERIENCE

The world didn’t end.

It disappeared.

I remember the constant sound of machines.

Cold lights above my head.

A voice calling my name, trying to keep me awake.

It was 2025.

The last thing I remember is the world as it was back then.

Then, silence.

When I open my eyes again, something is wrong.

No one.

No movement.

No continuity.

The hospital is empty rooms abandoned, as if time itself had stopped.

Outside, the world I knew no longer exists.

Years have passed.

Ten, maybe more.

But no calendar truly confirms it.

The Gargano has changed.

Real places once familiar, now feel suspended, trapped in an endless wait:

Monte Sant’Angelo. Foresta Umbra.

San Severo, Apricena, Foggia.

Peschici, Vico del Gargano…

Places I recognize.

Places that no longer recognize me.

And above all, I search for those who should never have disappeared..

Key Features

  • Explore a grounded, atmospheric world inspired by real locations from the Gargano region in Italy.

  • Survive by managing basic needs such as hunger, thirst, and exposure.

  • Dynamic weather and changing environmental conditions that affect movement, risk, and decision-making.

  • A persistent world: forced doors remain forced, collected items do not respawn, and your actions leave lasting marks.

  • Stealth-driven tension where sound matters—footsteps and noise can attract danger.

  • Scavenge, craft, and adapt using limited resources as you push deeper into the unknown.

  • Engage in close-range encounters using your fists or a variety of weapons discovered throughout the world.

  • Approach situations through stealth, observation, or direct confrontation, depending on your choices and available resources.

  • Experience slower, investigative moments alongside more intense and dangerous sequences.

  • Cinematic encounters that may include contextual actions and timed sequences during key moments.

  • Discover and use vehicles to traverse the world.

  • Interact with wildlife and hostile creatures that inhabit the environment.

  • Customize and equip clothing to adapt to environmental conditions and survival needs.

  • A single-player narrative campaign featuring cinematic sequences, a story with a clear beginning and end, and optional side activities.

  • Inventory and equipment management designed to support long-term survival and adaptation.

  • Some obstacles can be overcome through force, tools, or alternative routes.

A WORD FROM THE CREATOR

BECOME LIFE is an independent project developed with a long-term vision.

I’ve been developing it solo since May 2023, without a budget, while balancing work and everyday life and becoming a father along the way.

I’ve always wanted to create videogames.

Not to prove something, but to tell a story.

This is one of many stories I’ve written, but it’s the one I could no longer keep on paper.

It needed to become a place something to walk through, something to live.

I don’t promise perfection.

I promise dedication, listening, and constant improvement throughout development.

Thank you for being here.

While inspired by real places, all characters, events, and narrative elements are entirely fictional.

Any resemblance to actual persons, living or dead, is purely coincidental.

"BLOK 200: Prologue" is an atmospheric visual novel with elements of psychological horror and surrealism, set in the universe of the Samosbor.

You are an impossible creature without a pulse or breath, but for some reason you are still alive. You awoke to another Samosbor in a stranger's hab-cell on one of the thousands of floors of the 200th Gigablock. It is also called Gigablock 2-00-TsKG-541. Your old life: your best friend, your technical college, your dreams and aspirations – was left behind somewhere in the quiet incubator block.

You will have to let go of the past, accept this sad present and understand who you are now. And also prepare to search for the one who came to you in a fantastic dream before your awakening.

The game focuses on:

  • narrative and atmosphere;

  • character psychology and personal stories;

  • uncovering the lore of the 200th Gigablock and the Gigakhrush itself.

Gameplay:

  • reading a branching narrative and dialogue-driven story;

  • making choices that influence the course of events and the ending;

  • an in-game interactive encyclopedia (Gigapedia) for deeper exploration of the world.

Features:

  • a dark post-Soviet cyberpunk setting in the megastructure;

  • an original world that exists within the established Samosbor canon while revealing it from new and unexpected perspectives;

  • an authentic diegetic retro-styled interface;

  • literally every player action has an impact on the plot;

A day at the warehouse

Your first day at Bob Company. Check orders on your tablet, find the right items on the shelves, and carry them to the packing station. As you complete orders and clear the shelves, you will settle into a working rhythm of your own.

There is no need to rush. Work at your own pace, without a time limit. Items packed by mistake return to where they belong. Buy a cleaning robot, and you can leave it to tidy up goods dropped on the floor, too.

A warehouse that gets easier

Spend the points you earn from deliveries on equipment and upgrades. The boxes you first carried by hand can go on a cart, be gathered with a powered vacuum, or be delivered by drones. With more tools, you gain new ways to handle the same orders.

Ship all the goods in the warehouse to earn a promotion and open a new work area. As you rise from Intern to Director, the shelves fill with an ever wider range of products, from groceries to game consoles, furniture, and robots. Carry more, ship with less effort, and enjoy watching your working day change.

What comes with a promotion

Work and equipment are not the only things that grow at Bob Company. As you move up the ranks, you will discover new sides of the company and the stories behind them.

Slow down between deliveries and take a look around. Things you once passed without a thought may start to look different. How much you learn about the company's secrets is up to your curiosity.

Features

  • A single-player, first-person warehouse sim at your own pace
  • Relaxed order fulfillment with no time limits or game over
  • Equipment upgrades and automation, from your hands to carts, powered vacuums, and drones
  • Five ranks from Intern to Director, with expanding work areas
  • The satisfaction of finding, carrying, and shipping 432 different products

Pig Out: Defuse with Your Crew! 🐷💣

You know how bomb defusal games work: someone says "cut the red wire," someone cuts it, and everyone goes home safe. No such luxury here. Because your team is made up of three unfortunate little pigs — one mute, one blind, and one deaf!

To crack open these complex, modular, and cartoon-styled briefcases, you have only one choice: build a flawless communication chain. But beware: this barnyard is packed with high amounts of misunderstanding, unjust accusations, and frantically scribbled notes!

Meet Your Crew!

  • 🐷 Mute Pig (The Expert): The defusal manual is theirs alone. They know all the answers, but they can't utter a single word! They must quickly scan the manual, grab their pen and paper, and write or draw the solutions for the Deaf Pig. Their only hope is that their frantic handwriting actually makes sense under pressure!

  • 🐷 Blind Pig (The Defuser): The only one who can actually touch the bomb and cut the wires. But they can't see the world or read the screens. Thankfully, their hearing is perfectly fine! They rely entirely on the instructions coming through the radio to defuse the bomb with their hooves.

  • 🐷 Deaf Pig (The Translator): The ultimate bridge of the team. They can't hear a thing, but their eyes are sharp. They closely read the notes and sketches scribbled by the Mute Pig, decode what they mean, and shout the instructions out loud to guide the Blind Pig.

Build Your Own Language!

How you build your communication chain, how you draw your clues, and how you pass the info along is entirely up to you. The game doesn't impose a method. Building a functional communication and drawing system out of this absolute madness is your job!

Features

  • 3-Player Co-op — No more, no less. Exactly three pigs required in this barnyard.

  • Asymmetric Roles — Every player sees, hears, and can do something completely different.

  • Write, Draw & Decode — When words fail, the pen does the talking! Race against the clock while trying to decipher the Mute Pig's messy handwriting.

  • Modular Briefcase Puzzles — Each briefcase features different modules, different decryption panels, and different kinds of panic.

  • Role-Restricted Voice Chat — In-game voice chat is strictly limited by your role. Hearing and writing correctly has never been this stressful!

  • Level System — Defuse the bombs to unlock new levels. The difficulty comes along for the ride.

Friendships are not guaranteed. Get ready for a mudbath!

What you get in the demo

  • Two graveyards, six stages — Whitewall Cemetery, then any one of the remaining six
  • 8 grand magic lines, 3 familiars
  • Saves, permanent upgrades and achievements are in the full game only

Clear the graveyard of monsters! And tidy the place up while you're at it.

Every edge of the board is your paddle. Fire spell-balls into the horde pouring out of the summoning circles and sweep the place clean! Miss your shot and it usually hits somebody else on the way back. Bad aim is still fun here.

Hit the weakness, blow away the wall too

Every monster is weak to fire, water or lightning. Kill one with its own weakness and the corpse detonates, setting off every monster that shares it. And that chain? Straight through walls. A screen packed with the dead, gone in one shot.

You pick the second graveyard yourself

The graveyards are linked by roads. Anything that escapes you flees down them into a neighbouring graveyard and digs in — tougher enemies, but much bigger payouts. In the full game that choice opens up across all seven.

In the full game

7 graveyards x 3 stages, 21 stages a run. 20 grand magic lines, 10 familiars. Weekly Challenge and Steam leaderboards. 20 achievements.
Want the rest? Wishlist it.

BORE is a survival horror game for 1–4 players. Play alone or work together online to operate a giant drilling machine. Explore four underground regions: Overgrown Caves, Crystal Caves, Lava Caves, and Deep Dark Caves. Collect minerals, relics, and other valuables. Your employer sets a required payment. Collect and sell enough valuables to pay it.

Work together at the machine's controls. Steer the drill, control its speed, watch its temperature, and load coolant cartridges. Use the cabin's map and instruments to guide teammates exploring the caves. The Core Recovery station lets you collect extra valuables from material cut by the drill. Automatic speed control helps you operate the machine when playing alone.

Stop drilling, open the door, and search the caves for valuables. Mine deposits with a pickaxe or explosives, and carry what you find back to the drill. Creatures can notice your footsteps, mining, and voice. Use lights and distractions to avoid some threats. Defend yourself against others with tools or stun devices. Different creatures need different tactics, and some cannot be killed.

The longer you stay underground, the more dangerous the caves become. Return before the cave collapses, bring your valuables inside the drilling machine, and close the door to keep pursuing creatures out. Decide whether to return to the surface and sell, or drill deeper to search for more valuable treasure. Equipment and valuables inside the machine stay aboard as you travel.

Sell your valuables at the surface depot. Use the money to make the required payment and buy supplies. Choose from 33 equipment and upgrade options at the shop. Buy lights, mining tools, radios, and implants that improve your abilities. Better drill bits unlock deeper regions. You can also bring back dead creatures to sell. Between trips, restock your supplies and feed or pet the depot cat.

  • Online co-op for up to four players, with voice chat that depends on distance. Use walkie-talkies or the cabin speaker to reach players farther away.

  • Operate physical levers, controls, and instruments inside the drilling machine. Manage drill speed, heat, and coolant while your crew works.

  • Changing cave layouts across four regions. Try the Daily Dig and compete on leaderboards based on the value you sell, with separate groups for each crew size.

  • 28 creature types with different behaviors. Some hunt by sound, some react to light, and some copy your crewmates' appearance or voices.

  • 46 types of valuables to collect and sell, including eight from Core Recovery. Selling a new type adds information to your collection record. The required payment increases as you progress.

  • Revive dying crewmates before time runs out. Recover dead crewmates' bodies and bring them back to the depot. If you die, you can watch the surviving players.

  • Carry heavy valuables together, throw tools and objects, and drag bodies. Items and characters react to impacts, falls, and collisions.

  • An interactive tutorial, training videos, controller support, customizable keyboard controls, sound captions, colorblind-friendly map markers, and a setting for players with a fear of swarming creatures.

YOU HAVE A JOB

The company has debts. Serious ones. Your boss handed you the keys to an ice cream truck, locked the door behind you, and gave you a number to hit every single day.

Nobody said what happens if you miss it. He did say he'd call.

SCOOP, SERVE, SURVIVE

Everything happens in first person, with your hands. Grab a cone, dig into the tub, stack the scoops, hand it through the window before the customer's patience runs out. Every order is a small race, and the line does not stop.

  • Ten flavors to unlock, each worth more than the last

  • Cones and cups with upgrade tiers that change what a customer will pay

  • Angry customers who cost you reputation — three stars, and that's all you get

  • A day cycle that turns short lunch shifts into long, dark evenings

BUILD A RUN THAT LASTS

Between shifts, cards land on your counter. Take one. Prices, patience, scoop speed, queue size, flavor bonuses, and a few things that hurt as much as they help.

Golden cards are stronger than anything else on the counter. They also raise tomorrow's quota. Your call.

  • 90+ cards across four rarities

  • Reroll the offer with the coins from your own tip jar

  • Boss deals over the phone: cash now, a worse quota later

HE ALWAYS COLLECTS

Miss the quota and the shortfall comes out of your own pocket. Run out of reputation and the shutter comes down on its own.

Then the lights go red, the alarm starts, and the phone rings one last time.

EVERY RUN IS A NEW SHIFT

Die, restart, get further. Four difficulty levels, a different card offer every time, and one number that keeps you coming back: how many days you lasted.

🎮 FREE DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!

Try the tutorial, Stage 1, and an epic boss battle right on this page!

🔥 BRAVERUN — Run, slash, and test your courage!

A fast‑paced 90s‑style retro action RPG brought back to life with modern gameplay. Cut down waves of enemies and challenge massive bosses — each with unique attack patterns that push your reflexes and decision‑making to the limit.

⚡Features

  • Strategic Boss Battles — Brute force won’t win here. Study enemy movements and strike at the perfect moment.

Thank you for checking out BRAVERUN! This project aims to recreate the intensity and momentum of 90s action RPGs, rebuilt with modern pacing and gameplay.

Your power is in the cards you can't draw.

Every creature card belongs to a strain. Play one and it doesn't hit for the number printed on it — it hits for the entire population of that strain, everywhere in your deck at once. Draw pile, discard, hand, all of it counts. You never need to find the right card. You only need it to exist.

Every card asks the same question, every turn.

HARVEST it for damage now, or SOW it to breed more of its strain and hit harder for the rest of the run. There is no energy bar. Your hand refills to five and every card in it is yours to spend — the cost of sowing is simply the damage you chose not to deal. Greed has an axis: go deep on one strain for a multiplier that collapses all at once, or go wide for something steady that never spikes.

Carrying capacity is the ceiling. Going over it is how you get ammunition.

Every strain has its own cap. Cross it and breeding stalls, the end of each turn spits Feral cards into your deck, and if two strains are over at once the larger one eats the smaller. Feral cards are dead weight you cannot play. They are also the only fuel for BLOOM.

BLOOM is a bomb you build out of your own mistakes.

Six Feral cards arm it, and a permanent gauge shows exactly what detonating deals and what it costs you — so it is never a random punishment. Hold at eighteen and it goes off on its own. Every turn you wait makes the bomb bigger, the recoil worse and your hand deader. Set it off and every strain collapses back to its cap; you rebuild from half a colony.

The enemies watch what you are breeding, and they leave you a tell.

Nineteen of them, every attack telegraphed two turns ahead with a condition written underneath it. Meet the condition before you end your turn and the blow lands light. The check reads your colony at the moment you stop — so the forecast is never only "how much is this going to hurt," it is "what am I allowed to do this turn."

Every run runs on different physics.

You sign a Contract before you pick a single strain, and it rewrites the rules for the whole run — one restriction and one compensation, never just "harder this time." Drought crushes every cap but breeds you an extra creature. Bare Hands takes PRUNE away entirely. Monoculture gives you one strain instead of two, then makes it enormous. Choke doubles your overflow and lets you detonate twice as early.

The run ends on a sheet worth posting.

Win or die, you get a Herbarium specimen page: the strains you raised, the mutations that drifted into them, your peak population, your Blooms, the Contract you signed. Ten strains, three visible growth stages each, six heritable mutations — the colony you finish with is not one anybody else has had.

Features

  • 25–40 minute runs — five layers, and a boss announced on the very first screen: The Gardener, The Glasshouse or The Seedsman
  • Ten strains with three growth stages each, nineteen enemies, six heritable mutations that drift as your colony breeds
  • Six Contracts that change the run's physics; eleven post-battle nodes with five on offer every time
  • Five verbs and no bloat — HARVEST, SOW, BURN, PRUNE, DETONATE. You never do multiplication; every card previews its own result on hover
  • A screenshot-ready Herbarium sheet at the end of every run, win or lose

ONE MORE RUN. ONE MORE RECORD

Bullets fill the screen. You've got a jump and a gun - use both, stay inside the lines, and see how long you last.

BULLETJUMP is a fast, twitchy arcade score-chaser built around one number: your score. Every run is a shot at the leaderboard - and someone is always one rank above you.

RISK IT FOR THE MULTIPLIER

Jump & Shoot - jump with one hand, aim and shoot with the other. Gravity always pulls you down, the screen edges are deadly, and every bullet you destroy is points.

Close Calls Pay - let bullets skim past you to grow your score multiplier all the way to x5. Get hit and it's gone.

Dash, Wave, Push & Clear - a burst dash and three cooldown abilities for the moments a good dodge isn't enough.

Earn Your Shields - keep shooting to earn shield charges. Each one forgives exactly one mistake.

12 Power-Ups - Spread, Twin, Rapid and Spiral Shot, Nova and Fan Barrages, Slow Time, Magnet, Invincibility and more.

EVERY BLOW IS A WORD. LEARN TO READ IT.


Babel Destiny is a hardcore isometric soulslike. God did not destroy the Tower of Babel: He sealed it with the confusion of tongues. You are the envoy sent to climb it, with a rod, a bell, and not one word of its language.

READ THE BLOW

Every enemy announces its attack with a word. Red: nothing stops it, roll. The Tower's statues teach you its letters, and the same blow starts to come in white: answer it with a parry, right as it lands. Read four in a row and the fourth one bursts.

BREAK THEM, THEN RING THE KNELL

Guard is a bar. Every parry notches it. Break it and they kneel, and a kneeling foe has one answer left: leap, and a bell falls from the sky. Not even the keeper is spared.

SPEAK IT BACK

Your powers are words: The Break, Wind Step, Winnow and Heaven's Call. Each one hits some foes where they are weak, and some it cannot touch. Every rank changes the word you see, not just its number.

CLIMB THE TOWER

Leap between floating islands, cross the bridges the ink writes for you, ride the floors that carry you over the sea and the lift that turns into a shortcut, and watch the altimeter count every metre you win. Some halls close behind you: they open when the last foe falls. Four strata, four keepers, forty floors. ...or not.

HARD, AND FAIR

Even one foe, one on one, will test you. But every blow tells you what it is before it lands. The difficulty is learning to read it. The Tower is climbed one stratum at a time, each a run of its own; fall, and part of your favor waits where you fell, until you walk back for it.
